name: Madagascar colony
locator: Paillard, p. 30 and note 43, reporting the Journal officiel of 20 March 1901.
method: colonial administrative estimate reported in an archival study
definition: All reported population categories, including French and assimilated civil residents and Asian residents. Regions not fully controlled by the colonial administration were omitted. The original category table, separate coverage of dependencies, military handling and reference day were not recovered. The difference against the reconstruction is an inter-source discrepancy without a geographic allocation.

name: Madagascar colony
locator: Paillard, pp. 30–32, Table I, government administrative report.
definition: Sum of 2,498,697 Malagasy, 8,906 Europeans and assimilated civilians, and 6,068 military. The table lists Nosy Be and Sainte-Marie separately within the colony. No separate Asian entry is supplied. The sum does not establish exhaustive colonial coverage.

name: Malagasy population reported by Acting Governor Pennequin
locator: Paillard, p. 30 and note 43. Letter of the acting governor to the United States consul.
definition: Malagasy population in administered regions, as reported on 14 April. Non-Malagasy residents and regions not fully controlled were excluded.

name: Madagascar in an anonymous administrative return
locator: Paillard, p. 30 and note 43, anonymous estimate in the same archival file as the Pennequin letter.
definition: The file gives 2,449,658 before allowing for regions not yet counted, and rounds the extension to 2,500,000. Date and population categories are approximate. Both figures describe the same estimate.

name: Madagascar, Malagasy population
locator: Table 41, 1901 row. Original quantities are rounded to thousands.
method: retrospective reproduction of an administrative count
definition: Malagasy series only, published in thousands. Do not treat the difference from the contemporary all-category estimate as a separately observed population.

name: Madagascar colony, civil population
locator: Printed p. 475, population and its distribution among three areas.
definition: Administrative civilian total excluding military. Centre 1,369,411, East 835,409, West 439,852. Proximity to the 1900 reconstruction is incidental across dates and counting scopes.
